full_judgment: 3. The suit was contested by defendant Nos. 15-17 who filed a joint written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and contending 'inter alia' that the land of C. S. plot No. 384 appertaining to Khatian No. 222 and that of C. S. plot No. 383 appertaining to Khatian No. 180 along with the other lands belonged to Sree Nath Pashi and Jalim Pashi respectively, that after the death of Sreenath Pashi and abandonment of the holding by Jalim Pashi the landlord Tribeni Das Mohanta and Abdul Makim alias Ahsanullah took Khas possession of the same in 1933 that Defendant No.15 took settlement of 2 Bighas of land appertaining to C. S plot No. 384 from the landlord Tribeni Das Mohanra and constructed his home stead on a portion of the said land, that Tribeni Das Mohanta subsequently executed and registered a Patta in favour of Defendant No. 15 on the 11th February 1947, that in 1947 the said Defendant No. 15 took settlement of 46 acre of land apprising to C. S. plot No. 383 and 385 from Ahsanullah that Aktar Khatoon and others obtained a decree against Sreenat Pasni in Rent suit No. 638 of 1951 for arrear of rents in respect of Khatian No. 222 that in execution of the said decree, the holding recording in Khatian No. 222 was sold in auction which was subsequence set aside on the prayer of the Defendant No. 15 that a registered Patta was executed by Ahsanullah on the 27th December 1954 in favour of the said Defendant No. 15 in respect of the said Iand in confirmation of the previous that Defendant No 16 and his sister Fatu Bibi purchased 3 3/4 Kathas of land from Defendant No.15 out of the C.S. plot No. 383, that Defendant No. 17 purchased 2 Kathas of land on the 5th May, 1960 by a registered Kabala and that neither the plaintiffs nor their predecessor had ever possessed the disputed land, On the basis of the aforesaid pleadings the following issues were framed:-
